llm.evidence: LC–MS was performed using an LTQ-Orbitrap instrument (ThermoFisher).
Data acquired by mass spectrometry was quantified using MaxQuant label-free quantification (LFQ) workflow
To enrich biotinylated proteins, 1 mg of nuclear extract was incubated for 30 min rotating at room temperature with 100 ul of streptavidin-coated magnetic beads (Invitrogen 65001).
